content.text: Web fundamentals encompass the core technologies, frameworks, and practices that every frontend engineer must master. From the foundational building blocks of HTML and CSS to modern frameworks like Angular and Next.js, these topics form the backbone of professional web development.
This learning path progresses from structural foundations through styling, performance optimization, accessibility compliance, and into production-grade frameworks that build upon these fundamentals.

items: HTML & CSS — Semantic markup, document structure, and core styling with modern layout techniques
Modern CSS — Advanced CSS features including Flexbox, Grid, custom properties, container queries, and cascade layers
Web Performance — Core Web Vitals, loading strategies, rendering optimization, and performance budgets
Accessibility — WCAG compliance, ARIA patterns, assistive technology support, and inclusive design
Angular — Google's TypeScript-based component framework for building enterprise single-page applications
Next.js — React meta-framework with SSR, SSG, ISR, and API routes for production applications
Next.js Fundamentals — Deep dive into Next.js architecture, file-system routing, data fetching, and deployment patterns
